ACME HEALTH — BUSINESS IMPACT ANALYSIS 2026 (EXCERPT)
Scope: Acme Pharmacy pharmacy claims platform. Approved by the business continuity
steering group, March 2026. Cited as "BIA 2026-03".

1. TIERING
Tier 0 — loss is felt by patients at the counter within the hour:
  adjudication, remittance.
Tier 1 — degrades the Tier-0 path or a back-office cycle within a day:
  pharmacy, pricing.
The shared platform layer (Kubernetes, network, identity, secrets, edge) is
not a business service and is given no objective of its own. It inherits the
tightest objective of the services running on it.

2. OBJECTIVES
  adjudication   RTO 60 min    RPO 15 min    Tier 0
  remittance     RTO 120 min   RPO 60 min    Tier 0
  pharmacy       RTO 240 min   RPO 60 min    Tier 1
  pricing        RTO 240 min   RPO 1440 min  Tier 1

3. NOTES FROM THE STEERING GROUP
a. The objectives above apply to the PRODUCTION environment only. Non-production
   environments carry no recovery commitment; they exist so that the procedure is
   proven before it is needed.
b. Pricing's 24-hour RPO is intentional: reference data is reloaded from the
   drug-price feed on a weekly cycle.
c. Pharmacy is tiered 1 although adjudication cannot answer a claim without it.
   Engineering flagged this; the steering group accepted the inconsistency for
   this cycle and asked for it to be revisited in the 2027 review.
d. Settlement loss must be DATABLE. A recovery point whose age cannot be stated
   is treated as a miss regardless of its size.
